title: Repair a path search
prompt: The connections in graph are one-way. Return true when to can be reached from from by following connections. A name can always reach itself.
hints: The failing check uses a graph in which a points to b and b points back to a. What does the starter do there?
Remember the names already visited, and do not visit one twice.
Keep a Set outside the recursive function. Return false for a name that is already in it, and add each name when you visit it.
checkLabels: One-way connections cannot be followed backwards.
A search that finds nothing must still end when the graph has a cycle.
A route inside a cycle is found.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Does not remember where it has been, so it goes round a cycle until the call stack is full.

feedback: The error names the call stack. That means the function kept calling itself. Which names does it visit, in order, on the graph with the cycle?
